title: The Hidden Heirloom
subtitle: A Quiet Detective Faces an Unexpected Challenge
summary: Byomkesh Bakshi, the celebrated 'Truth Seeker,' finds himself in a lull, with little crime to chase—until an intriguing situation starts to brew. As boredom gnaws at his companion, a new mystery seems poised to break the monotony. Dive into a world where secrets lurk beneath a calm surface, and even the quietest days can spark the most captivating investigations.
